answer.rationale: b1 confirms release-rollback cleared checkout regressions quickly, but compliance forbids reverting the security patch, so that lever is blocked. b2 confirms regional failover has previously restored latency inside minutes without customer impact. Write-path p99 is climbing and confined to the primary region, and settlement traffic is at its daily peak, so shifting the primary-region write path to a healthy region directly addresses the bounded degradation. Read-replica routing (b5) and circuit breakers (b4) help but don't relieve primary write pressure. Add_capacity (b3) is too slow for a 5x p99 surge already in progress. Failover preserves customer writes — the primary objective.
